workingTitle: MeerKAT detects the combined hydrogen signal of distant galaxies

freshness.publicationStatus: Accepted for publication in Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society; first public as arXiv:2610.12158 on 2026-10-08

coreFacts: MeerKLASS measured the 21-centimeter neutral-hydrogen auto-spectrum directly at redshift 0.42.
The analysis used 2021 MeerKAT data covering about 236 square degrees and 971.2 to 1023.6 MHz.
Independent data subsets were cross-correlated to suppress noise and uncorrelated systematics.
The inferred detection has signal-to-noise ratio 6.2.
Individual subset auto-spectra retain excess power attributed to unresolved systematics, a stated limitation.
